about: What the kit types into the chat. No scenario list had been stored before 2026-10-12; this one is assembled from the repo: the staff test prompts (AdminAiPlanner QUICK_PROMPTS), the examples the chat prompt itself gives (PromptRenderer PACKAGES_BLOCK), the homepage and /plan starters, and the chat bugs reported on 2026-10-07..09 (river cruise with a private show, shooting kalashnikov, what else can we add). Each entry states the outcome to expect, never the wording.
brief: Plan 2 nights for 10 of us — nightlife first

typed.expect: the activity goes in and the chat asks which extra
typed.source: prompt rule: "put the beer bike in" is a command to ADD; owner rule 2026-10-12

typed.expect: the extra goes on, no price in the reply, no second question

typed.say: how much is the {A.other} on the {A}?
typed.expect: the reply names no price and changes nothing
typed.source: owner rule 2026-10-12: extras are priced on the card only

typed.expect: activity and extra in one turn, no extras question after it
typed.source: bug S56 (2026-10-09) and kit run 2026-10-12: an extra asked for on an activity the plan lacks adds the activity first (PackageEditor)

typed.expect: activities are offered, nothing is changed
typed.source: prompt rule: a wish for a kind of activity is not an edit

typed.expect: a question back, no list of activities, nothing changed
typed.source: prompt rule: an open question that names no kind

typed.expect: not on offer: nothing added that was not asked for
typed.source: prompt rule: something not in the catalog is never silently substituted
staff prompt: "Remove the karting from all packages."

typed.expect: the brief changes; the reply names no extra price
typed.source: staff prompt: "Actually we are 12 people now."

placeholders: {A} and {B} are two activities NOT in the plan when the typed part starts that offer one of the extras the chat suggests (private show, topless hostess, more bullets); {A.extra} / {B.extra} is that extra, {A.other} another extra of A. Resolved by the kit at run time so the outcome does not depend on what the model put in the plan.
